faq.q: What is a titanium craniofacial mesh?
faq.a: A titanium craniofacial mesh is a precision-machined craniofacial component used in reconstruction mesh for craniofacial repair (cp-ti). Manufactured from Grade 2 CP-Ti for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium craniofacial mesh?
faq.a: Titanium Craniofacial Mesh is designed for reconstruction mesh for craniofacial repair (cp-ti). The Grade 2 CP-Ti grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium craniofacial mesh manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Craniofacial Mesh is manufactured using VAR melting. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium craniofacial mesh?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
